eval_dimensions.name: Confirm Before Apply
eval_dimensions.description: Changes are confirmed through AskUserQuestion before the --apply run, with exactly one Recommended option listed first

eval_dimensions.name: Plugin Skills Handled per Plugin
eval_dimensions.description: Plugin skills are never written to skillOverrides; a plugin is disabled whole only when all of its skills are irrelevant

eval_dimensions.name: Project-Local Scope
eval_dimensions.description: Writes only project-local .claude/settings.local.json unless the user explicitly asks for another scope

eval_dimensions.name: Incremental Re-runs
eval_dimensions.description: A re-run shows existing overrides, proposes only undecided skills, and honours the allowlist

evals.name: Django backend hides frontend skills
evals.description: Standalone frontend skills are hidden after confirmation; an all-frontend plugin is proposed for disabling
evals.input: /dev10x:skill-prune in a repo with pyproject.toml (django) and no frontend files; svelte and impeccable plugins installed

assertions.signal: Runs 'dev10x skill prune-overrides' without --apply and shows its plan
svelte is proposed via --disable-plugin, never as svelte:* entries in skillOverrides

evals.name: Second run proposes only new skills
evals.description: Existing overrides are shown first; an unchanged re-run reports has_changes false
evals.input: /dev10x:skill-prune in a project whose settings.local.json already has skillOverrides

assertions.signal: Already-decided skills are not re-proposed; an unchanged rerun reports has_changes false

evals.name: Allowlisted skill is never proposed
evals.description: A name under keep: in ~/.config/Dev10x/skill-prune.yaml stays visible

assertions.signal: frontend-design appears under kept_by_allowlist, not skill_changes

evals.name: Persisting a kept name is asked
evals.description: A name the user keeps is added to the allowlist only through AskUserQuestion
evals.input: /dev10x:skill-prune; the user keeps one proposed skill

assertions.signal: An allowlist question lists the kept name, 'Keep for this project only (Recommended)' first

evals.name: No user-scope write by default
evals.description: Without an explicit request, nothing is written outside .claude/settings.local.json

assertions.signal: The --apply run targets .claude/settings.local.json; ~/.claude/settings.json and .claude/settings.json are untouched
